title: RLM Sub-calls + DataStore Implementations
description:
Implement RLM sub-calls and DataStore from docs/plans/07-code-interpreter.md.

Sections: §4.4-§4.6 (DataStore interface, SearchableDataStore, DataStore implementations), §5.2 (RLM builtins), §5.3 (Token/Cost Budget), §5.4 (RLM Implementation), §5.6 (RLM concurrent dispatch)

Key deliverables:
- llm_call builtin: single RLM sub-call with isolated context, usage tracking
- llm_batch builtin: parallel dispatch via errgroup, budget tracking
- Token/cost budget enforcement (token_budget_exceeded)
- DataStore interface: Write, Read, ReadRange, List, Delete, Close
- SearchableDataStore interface with Search method
- MemoryDataStore: in-memory map-based, bounded by configurable memory limit (default 16MB)
- FSDataStore: filesystem-backed, range reads, regex search
- BlobDataStore: cloud object storage (S3/GCS), range reads, ErrNotSupported for search
- SQLDataStore: SQL query interface, key-value table backend
- store_* builtins: store_write, store_read, store_read_range, store_search, store_list, store_delete
- Unit tests for all builtins + DataStore implementations

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md
See Implementation Guide §5 (Seam: codeinterp ↔ ai.Provider for llm_call/llm_batch)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/07-code-interpreter.md §4.4-§5.6
- Test harness: docs/plans/07-code-interpreter-test-harness.md
- Depends on: T7 (Starlark Runtime + Core Builtins)
